messages:
anya: starting a config-only deploy to tighten routing fallback and lower max batch to curb p99 spikes. canary now.
deploy-bot: deploy queued (cfg-id: snap-2026-03-21-tight), env=prod, mode=config-only, canary=5% us-central-1 for 10m
wei: noted. dashboards: p99_gen_latency, kvcache_hit_ratio, and queue_depth. alerts adjusted: p99 > 700ms for 3m triggers hold
tom: quick checklist: no model pins, update release spreadsheet, and smoke test flows ready
anya: config excerpt: 
```
routing:
  fallback: latency_then_cost
limits:
  per_tenant_max_inflight: 45  # was 110
batching:
  max_batch_size: 50         # was 128
timeouts:
  start_to_first_token_ms: 1100
```
sre-bot: log created: snap-2026-03-21-tight started by anya. rollback condition: sustained p99 > 800ms or error rate +0.5% for 4m
deploy-bot: canary started -> target 5% us-central-1, id=cfg-6376
wei: canary +6m: one shard p99=520ms (baseline 400), kvcache_hit_ratio -4%, queue depth spike on shard-2 for 90s
anya: pause ramp. leave canary at 5% while we investigate shard-2.
tom: applying a tiny kv idle bump (kv_idle_seconds 58) to reduce churn on shard affinity, will patch canary
deploy-bot: config patch applied (cfg-id: snap-2026-03-21-tight-v1), kv_idle_seconds=58. health probes restarting
wei: +4m after patch p99 back to 410ms, kvcache within 1% baseline, no new queue spikes
anya: good to proceed. ramp to 30% in 10m, full at +70m if stable. remember to add release note blurb.
